VBO:0200328.summary: Playful Joy and cuddle-loving Hope are sisters whom Chihuahua Rescue & Transport reported as six-and-a-half-year-old Chihuahua–Bichon mixes. They enjoyed toys and sofa time, greeted their foster mother eagerly, and curled up together at bedtime. Unfamiliar noises could draw barking from the pair.
